description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus (FTS5 + voyage-law-2 embeddings, claude-opus-5 contextual summaries) + forms catalog. 10 docs / 527 blocks, tax year 2025.
_notes: GitHub Release asset (corpus-v1 tag). NOTE: repo is private — unauthenticated download 404s until the repo goes public; until then corpus:fetch falls back to CORPUS_SEED_PATH or 'gh release download corpus-v1'. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
